player_prompt.intro:
I ni jɛgɛ Player {player_id} ka taa Pig Dice.

Kulaw:
- Ni i taa bɛɛ, i ka taa '[roll]' wala '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Kɔnɔntɔ i taa jumla
- Roll 1: Kɔsɔ i taa jumla ani taa fɔ
- Hold: Kɔnɔntɔ i taa jumla i skɔrɛ ani taa fɔ
- Fɔlɔ i {winning_score} pɔinti i ye kɛlen

Ni i taa bɛɛ, i bɛna wɛrɛ i skɔrɛw ani taa jumla.
Kɛ i '[roll]' fɔ i taa dɔrɔmɛ wala '[hold]' fɔ i pɔintiw bɔ.
